maudhui: (1) Every citizen of the United Republic has the right to freedom of movement in the United Republic and the right to live in any part of the United Republic, to leave and enter the country, and the right not to be forced to leave or be expelled from the United Republic. (2) Any lawful act or any law which is intended to - (a) curtail a person's freedom of movement and to restrain or imprison him; or (b) limit a person from exercising his freedom of movement so as to comply with the obligations or duties arising under another law; or (c) protect public interest in general or preserve certain special interests or interests of a certain section of the public, such act or law shall not be construed or be held to be repugnant to or inconsistent with the provisions of this Article.
